Patch Set 16: Code-Review+2
Change has been successfully merged

What is the behavior if there are no completed tasks in the queue?

From looking at the code change it looks like it will still remove the oldest. Maybe clarify the commit message to indicate it will first try to remove the oldest completed task.
Done
One suggestion on adjustment to commit message, but otherwise looks good to me.
aren't there more states than just != running we should avoid deleting?
I think only 'Running' and 'Pending' might be worth considering here. Others are just stopped in different states and not active.
This probably needs to be to disallow new requests, right, rather than delete an in-flight task?
Do you mean, if all the tasks are running tasks and queue is full, we should not allow creation of new tasks ?
Not sure we will ever hit a production case where all tasks are in running state. I would prefer to allow the new task creation than to block it.

I assume the motive is to remove the tasks with states - Stopping, Completed, Killed, Exception, Cancelled.

So, should you check for other task states as well - Starting, Suspended, Interrupted?
Done
Please don't declare static maps like this.  They take up memory at all times.  Declare this as an array
yes moved to array.

these are other active task states which are not included here.
"Stopping" = taskAborted
"Completed" = taskCompletedOK
"Killed" = taskRemoved
"Exception" = taskCompletedWarning
"Cancelled" = taskCancelled
is there any reason why these states are skipped?

all the above tasks have reached completed state and some might not be successful. I have kept the logic simple to prefer only pending/running/suspended task and remove everything that is either completed or failed.
